measurement: Final transcript to first scheduled output audio; not acoustic onset or end-to-end latency.
limitations: Seven finalized turns; five TTS cancellations and two stream finishes are not seven uninterrupted completions.
Final-to-scheduled-audio excludes user speaking and endpoint decision time, and is not measured acoustic onset.
First model fragment, complete model response, complete TTS stream and first scheduled audio are different metrics.
